topic.source_contract: Building regulations approval, building-control routes and completion evidence

routes: Building Safety Regulator for higher-risk work
building control body for other work
facts.future_levy: certain applications may be subject from 2026-10-01
facts.guard: future levy is not applied early and approval is not planning permission
submission or building notice is not a completion certificate
approver registration is not project approval

scope_guards: Planning permission and building regulations approval are distinct decisions.
Higher-risk and non-higher-risk building-control routes remain distinct.
Full plans, building notice and regularisation have different evidence and legal effects.
A building notice is not formal plans approval or a completion certificate.
Building-control approval is not proof that works were built in accordance with the approval.
A completion-certificate application is not an issued certificate, structural warranty or title evidence.
Registered building control approver status is not project-specific approval.
No score or promotion is written without exact work scope, route, approval, inspections, changes, completion and planning evidence.
